description: Frequency of the LMTK3 catalytic-loop and Mg-motif variants across 430 reviewed human kinase domains, with Fisher test for DYG/non-RD co-occurrence
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ================= rebuild kinome table (provenance: full code, not a summary) =================
url="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
q="(taxonomy_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (xref:pfam-PF00069 OR xref:pfam-PF07714)"
items=[]; cursor=None
while True:
    p={"query":q,"fields":"accession,gene_primary,sequence,ft_domain","format":"json","size":500}
    if cursor: p["cursor"]=cursor
    r=requests.get(url,params=p,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status()
    res=r.json()["results"]; items+=res
    m=re.search(r"cursor=([^&>]+)", r.headers.get("Link",""))
    if not m or not res: break
    cursor=m.group(1)

def kd_and_motifs(e):
    s=e["sequence"]["value"]; dom=None
    for f in e.get("features",[]):
        if f["type"]=="Domain" and "Protein kinase" in f["description"]:
            dom=(int(f["location"]["start"]["value"]),int(f["location"]["end"]["value"])); break
    if not dom: return None
    kd=s[dom[0]-1:dom[1]]; off=dom[0]; cl=None
    for m in re.finditer(r"[A-Z].D[A-Z]",kd):
        p=m.start()
        if 0.35*len(kd)<p<0.82*len(kd) and p+8<=len(kd) and kd[p+7]=='N' and kd[p] in "HYNRKQ":
            cl=(kd[p:p+8],off+p); break
    if not cl: return None
    mm=re.search(r"D[A-Z]G",kd[cl[1]-off+12:cl[1]-off+48])
    return dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"], gene=e.get("genes",[{}])[0].get("geneName",{}).get("value",""),
                cat_loop=cl[0], cat_pos=cl[1], mg=mm.group() if mm else "none",
                mg_pos=cl[1]+12+mm.start() if mm else None)

K=pd.DataFrame([x for x in (kd_and_motifs(e) for e in items) if x])
K["HRD1"]=K.cat_loop.str[1]; K["p4"]=K.cat_loop.str[4]
print("entries fetched %d | kinase domains parsed %d | unparsed %d"%(len(items),len(K),len(items)-len(K)))

LM=["LMTK3","LMTK2","AATK"]
n_hsd=(K.HRD1=='S').sum(); n_dyg=(K.mg=='DYG').sum(); n_both=((K.HRD1!='R')&(K.mg=='DYG')).sum()
n_sig=(K.cat_loop=="HSDLALRN").sum()
print("HRD+1=S: %d/%d (%.2f%%) -> %s"%(n_hsd,len(K),100*n_hsd/len(K),sorted(K[K.HRD1=='S'].gene)))
print("DYG    : %d/%d (%.2f%%) -> %s"%(n_dyg,len(K),100*n_dyg/len(K),sorted(K[K.mg=='DYG'].gene)))
print("HSDLALRN exactly: %d -> %s"%(n_sig,sorted(K[K.cat_loop=='HSDLALRN'].gene)))
# Fisher: is DYG enriched among non-RD kinases?
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
tab=[[n_both,(K.HRD1!='R').sum()-n_both],[n_dyg-n_both,(K.HRD1=='R').sum()-(n_dyg-n_both)]]
OR,pv=fisher_exact(tab); print("DYG x non-RD co-occurrence: OR=%.1f p=%.2g  table=%s"%(OR,pv,tab))
n_A=(K.p4=='A').sum(); n_K=(K.p4=='K').sum()
print("catalytic-loop +4 Ala (TK-type): %d (%.1f%%) | Lys (STK-type): %d (%.1f%%)"%(n_A,100*n_A/len(K),n_K,100*n_K/len(K)))
K.to_csv("human_kinome_catalytic_motifs.csv",index=False)

# ================= figure =================
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16.5,4.8))

v=K.HRD1.value_counts().head(8)
cols=['#b0b6bd']*len(v); cols[list(v.index).index('S')]='#c0392b'
ax[0].bar(range(len(v)),v.values,color=cols); ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(v))); ax[0].set_xticklabels(v.index)
ax[0].set_yscale('log'); ax[0].set_xlabel("residue at HRD+1 (the R of HRD)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("human kinase domains (log)")
ax[0].set_title("A  LMTK3 is non-RD: HSD, shared with\nonly AATK, LMTK2, TTK (4/430)",fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax[0].annotate("LMTK3\nAATK, LMTK2, TTK",xy=(list(v.index).index('S'),4),xytext=(4.2,30),fontsize=8,color='#c0392b',
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color='#c0392b'))

v2=K.mg.value_counts().head(8)
cols2=['#b0b6bd']*len(v2); cols2[list(v2.index).index('DYG')]='#c0392b'
ax[1].bar(range(len(v2)),v2.values,color=cols2); ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(v2))); ax[1].set_xticklabels(v2.index,rotation=45)
ax[1].set_yscale('log'); ax[1].set_xlabel("Mg2+-binding motif (DFG position)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("human kinase domains (log)")
ax[1].set_title("B  LMTK3 carries DYG, found in 10/430\n(all LMTKs, VRK1/2, PRKCI/Z, LRRK2, GRK5, NEK9)",fontsize=10,loc='left')

lab=["catalytic-loop +4\n= Ala (TK type)","catalytic-loop +4\n= Lys (STK type)","other"]
val=[n_A,n_K,len(K)-n_A-n_K]
ax[2].bar(range(3),val,color=['#c0392b','#2e6da4','#b0b6bd'])
ax[2].set_xticks(range(3)); ax[2].set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8); ax[2].set_ylabel("human kinase domains")
ax[2].set_title("C  The TK-type signature LMTK3 carries is shared\nby %d kinases: it marks kinome branch, not specificity"%n_A,fontsize=10,loc='left')
for i,x in enumerate(val): ax[2].text(i,x+5,str(x),ha='center',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
